name: My little flying pet shop
detailed_description:
High above the clouds lies the Cloud Archipelago — a newly discovered chain of floating islands, home to charming animal settlers carving out new lives in the skies. As a new member of the Sky Caravan, a guild of adventurous merchants, you’ll connect distant communities, trading goods, sharing stories, and helping towns grow. Tend crops, catch fish, seek rare products, and upgrade your airship to reach far-off lands. Explore this cozy frontier and uncover the mystery of why these islands float.

Trade, Travel, and Thrive

Sail between vibrant islands alive with bustling markets and curious locals. Each stop offers new opportunities — buy low, sell high, and seek out rare goods to grow your fortune. Whether you’re chasing the perfect trade route or simply soaking in the skies, every voyage holds a story waiting to unfold.

Grow, Fish, and Gather

Between trading trips, explore island farms and tranquil lakes to grow fresh crops, fish in clear waters, and gather goods from the wild. Stock up on the produce, seafood, and local specialties that will keep your shelves full and your customers coming back.

Upgrade & Customize Your Airship

Transform your humble vessel into a legendary flying shop: expand your storage to carry more goods, increase speed to reach distant islands, or even get a bigger airship. Unlock upgrades through quests and hidden discoveries, then personalize your vessel with custom air balloons, colors, and cozy decorations.

Explore the Cloud Archipelago

Discover a diverse world of floating islands, from lush forests to golden savannas and snowy peaks. Each region offers its own settlers, resources, and trading opportunities. Overcome distance and weather to reach new destinations, unlock hidden routes, and expand your map.

A Sky Full of Stories

Meet memorable animal characters, each with their own quirks, needs, and dreams. Take on quests that shape the growth of towns, strengthen communities, and reveal fragments of the archipelago’s hidden past. Piece together the mystery of why the islands float as you trade, travel, and explore.

Wishlist Now, Merchant!

The Cloud Archipelago is calling. Build your legend as the most renowned flying shopkeeper in the skies — and uncover the mysteries hidden among the clouds.

Wishlist now and be ready to set sail when the winds are in your favor!

  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 970 / RX 480 (4GB+ of VRAM)
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:

  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 2.8 GHz / AMD Ryzen 7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 2060 Super / RX 5700 XT (8GB+ of VRAM)
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
